answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The mesa is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the orchard. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the crystal of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
